description: Test table for the deterministic `rules` provider of harness.decision.v1.DecisionService (packages/core/src/decision/rules.ts). Shared with the Go client's local copy. Each case: input = {tool_name, input (tool input object), cwd?, additional_directories?, facts?}; missing cwd / additional_directories take the values in `defaults`. expected = allow | deny | ask; categories = the exact set of RiskCategory names (lowercase, without the RISK_CATEGORY_ prefix) of a deny, [] otherwise. rule = the id of the rule that decides (both implementations must name the same rule). rules_version = BUILTIN_RULES_VERSION of the rule set this table describes (rules.ts and rulesengine.go). Rule options are the defaults (protected branches main, master, release*; no admin extras).
